title: chore: remove dead code in logger.rs to eliminate build warnings
body:
Six `dead_code` warnings emitted during `npx tauri dev` from unused structured logging and deny-list redaction infrastructure in `logger.rs`.

- Removed `LogEntry` struct, `log_event()`, `DENY_LIST`, `init_deny_list()`, `redact_value()`, `redact_str()`
- Removed `log_info!`, `log_warn!`, `log_err!` macros (sole consumers of the above, also unused)
- Removed now-unnecessary `use serde::Serialize` import
